title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
summary: OpenAI 宣布其模型成功推翻了一个离散几何领域的中心猜想，这是 AI 在纯数学研究中取得的重要突破。该成果展示了 AI 在数学推理和反例构造方面的潜力，可能改变数学研究范式。

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash
raw_excerpt: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Flash, a new model focused on agentic workflows, coding, and long-horizon task execution. The release also expanded Gemini access across Search, enterprise tools, Android Studio, and Google's developer platforms.
summary: Google 发布 Gemini 3.5 Flash 模型，专注于智能体工作流、编程和长周期任务执行。该模型在 Google I/O 大会上亮相，并扩展至搜索、企业工具、Android Studio 等平台，标志着 Google 在 AI 智能体领域的重大进展。

title: Karpathy joins Anthropic
raw_excerpt: Andrej Karpathy announced he has joined Anthropic, citing the next few years at the LLM frontier as especially formative for his return to R&D. Karpathy noted he remains passionate about education and plans to resume that work later, signaling the move is research-focused rather than a permanent pivot away from teaching.
summary: 知名 AI 研究员 Andrej Karpathy 宣布加入 Anthropic，专注于前沿 LLM 研究。Karpathy 表示仍对教育保持热情，未来可能回归教学，此次加入是研究导向的决策，对 AI 人才格局产生重要影响。

title: OpenAI announces new Guaranteed Capacity offering for customers to secure compute
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's new Guaranteed Capacity offering allows customers to secure long-term access to compute to power AI products, agents, and workflows. Customers can choose between one-, two-, and three-year-long commitments, with discounts based on how long the commitment is. The company will offer Guaranteed Capacity until it sells out of its current allocation. It plans to offer it again in the future.
summary: OpenAI 推出“保证容量”服务，允许客户锁定 1-3 年的长期计算资源，以支持 AI 产品、智能体和工作负载。此举旨在解决算力短缺问题，并为企业客户提供更稳定的基础设施保障。

title: Real-Time Long Video Generation (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA's LongLive 1.0 is a framework for interactive long-form video generation that supports sequential prompting and real-time user-guided editing using streaming attention and KV-cache optimization techniques.
summary: NVIDIA 开源 LongLive 1.0 框架，支持实时长视频生成，通过流式注意力和 KV 缓存优化实现交互式编辑。该工具允许用户通过连续提示引导视频生成，对视频创作和 AI 内容生成领域具有重要价值。

title: Cerebras is now running Kimi K2.6
raw_excerpt: Kimi K2.6, a trillion-parameter model, has the fastest frontier model performance ever measured by Artificial Analysis at around 1,000 tokens per second.
summary: Cerebras 宣布运行 Kimi K2.6 万亿参数模型，在 Artificial Analysis 评测中达到约 1000 tokens/秒的前沿性能，成为最快的前沿模型。这展示了专用 AI 芯片在推理速度上的巨大优势。

title: Intuit to lay off over 3k employees to refocus on AI
summary: Intuit 宣布裁员超 3000 人，以将业务重心转向 AI。这是传统软件公司加速 AI 转型的又一重大举措，反映了 AI 对就业结构和企业战略的深远影响。

title: tinyhumansai/openhuman
raw_excerpt: Your Personal AI super intelligence. Private, Simple and extremely powerful.
summary: GitHub 上开源项目 OpenHuman 今日获得 3394 星，该项目旨在打造个人 AI 超级智能，强调隐私、简洁和强大性能。其高关注度反映了社区对本地化、隐私优先 AI 助手的强烈需求。
